name: b14_sword
title: Crane Kart: sword strikes
note: b14's own strikes with the long sword in her right hand (10-17; she fought with the motion pack's punches since joining on 10-11, her sword only in her game's own clips), as Inase's a08_sword and Kart's b10_axe. Her game's battle stance holds the sword reversed, the blade up along her forearm; in every swing of her skills she turns it into a forward grip, so the grip is the one she cuts with (tools/roe/b14_grip.json, skill_01 frames 18-48; RoeGrips on Wp_01, the sword's own bone - Bip001 Prop1 and Wp_01..04 only the battle rig has, grafted). Picked from b14_sword_candidates.json (out/b14_sword_candidates.mp4): A the fast cut and the low one that end her skill_01's dash; B the leap of skill_01, the blade sweeping along the floor as she takes off (Low: block crouching); C the turn of her skill_02 - the blade over her head and on into a thrust at her chest's height (High: it passes over a crouching foe); D Vindictus' Attack_Strong03b, a flying turn with a cut across as she lands (knocks down; neither Fiona's, Inase's nor b10's). Each hits while the tip sweeps through the front ("hit", clip seconds, from RoeMotionPacks.Import -roeTips: the farthest, fastest stretch; measured whole, the tip of a 1.2 m sword is over 5 m/s nearly all the time). who / src / zh are notes for people and the videos.
source: Rise of Eros (b14 skill_01, skill_02); Vindictus: Defying Fate 2024-03 pre-alpha (Fiona's AnimSequences, Assets/VDF/fio005/anims)
